description: INTEMARES_A22B Provincias Fisiográficas Montes Submarinos Canal de Mallorca is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). The information contained in this dataset is the layer of physiographic provinces built on the basis of expert judgment from bathymetry (16 m resolution), as well as its derived layers of slope and orientation of the seabed. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "INTEMARES_A22B Physiographic Provinces Submarine Mountains Canal de Mallorca" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bathymetry, Pendiente, Provincias fisiográficas, Physiographic provinces, LIFE, Orientación. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
